page.notes: Hebrew words in the top lines are only approximately copied: their exact pointing and letters could not be read with certainty and are left as placeholders. The initial letter of the first entry is a large capital and its Greek reading is doubtful. The ornament row of fleurons is not text and is omitted. The right part of the page is not present in this section. Greek and Hebrew entries are partly cut off at the edges and several Greek words are uncertain; they are marked [?] where doubtful. The decorative band between the columns and the heading is not transcribed as text. The scan is cut off at the top and the right; Greek words are transcribed as far as legible, with doubtful letters left unmarked where the scan is clear enough. Several Greek headwords are uncertain and may be misread.
